title: Split work into balanced ranges
prompt: Return exactly workers half-open index ranges covering [0,n), with no overlap. Earlier ranges receive any extra elements. Their lengths differ by at most one. Empty ranges are allowed. Throw std::invalid_argument when workers is zero. Tests use at most eight workers.

tests.label: Remainder first
tests.hint: Give one extra item to each of the first n%workers ranges.

tests.label: More workers than items
tests.hint: Keep all requested ranges, including empty ones.

tests.label: No items
tests.hint: Empty work still has two empty ranges.

hints: Use n/workers for the shared base length.
The end of one range is the beginning of the next.
explanation: Balanced, nonoverlapping half-open ranges are a useful starting contract for parallel writes. This exercise calculates the ranges; it does not launch GPU or CPU work.
